title: The Spectrap
author: Alex Ball
description:
A witch has trapped you in a cellar in the woods with only an old-fashioned projector for company. How will you get out of this one?

This is a short escape game aimed at younger children, based around the theme of colours. There are some puzzles to solve but no nasty surprises.

Certain aspects of the game reflect the interests of the children who first played it.
